lines.text: By itself, it points nowhere. It could be the edge of a river — or the place your money sleeps.
Now watch what context does. The river flooded the bank.
River got there first — and it pulls bank toward the water, toward the land's edge. Same word. New direction.
Reset it. I deposited my paycheck at the bank.
Paycheck pulls the other way — toward buildings, toward money. The word didn't change. Its direction did.
That's how the machine holds meaning: every word is a direction, and the words before it set where it points.
